source.failure: The Android release registrant included the dev-only integration_test plugin, but release Gradle excluded its implementation, causing GeneratedPluginRegistrant.java compilation to fail.

fix: Moved the macOS Keychain integration test into an isolated QA Flutter host and removed integration_test from the production app dependencies.

checks.name: Production Android release build
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile && flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --no-pub
checks.observation: Flutter 3.47.5 produced all three ABI APKs after a clean dependency resolution; the generated production Android registrant no longer references integration_test. Local artifacts are not release-published APKs.

checks.name: Isolated macOS Keychain integration test
checks.command: cd desktop/qa/macos_keychain_integration && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile && flutter test integration_test/macos_keychain_roundtrip_test.dart -d macos && flutter analyze integration_test/macos_keychain_roundtrip_test.dart
checks.observation: The isolated Keychain round-trip passed and the test analyzed without issues.

checks.name: GitVerse signed release publish
checks.reason: Must run from the new android-v1.0.11 tag; the failed android-v1.0.10 tag is intentionally left unchanged.

failure_or_blocker: The GitVerse signed release and physical-device acceptance remain pending.
